d: Trump trade adviser Peter Navarro says he was “firebombed” online by Indian critics after repeatedly attacking New Delhi over trade and its purchases of Russian oil. Navarro has called India the “Maharaja of tariffs” and a “laundromat for the Kremlin.” India has rejected his claims as “inaccurate and misleading,” while defending its right to buy energy in its national interest. Meanwhile, Shubhangi Sharma tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
